crossRefs.note: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…

translations.web: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
translations.bsb: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
translations.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.
translations.asv: I hate them with perfect hatred: They are become mine enemies.
